title: A Controlled Evaluation of Curvature Inspired Scalar Feature Scaling for Domain Generalization
abstract: arXiv:2610.18227v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Domain-specific curvature is an appealing idea for domain generalization (DG), but curvature learning can denote substantially different computations. This paper evaluates one deliberately narrow implementation: the code calls it HyperDG, but it rescales Euclidean encoder features during training by learned positive scalars and uses an ordinary linear classifier on unscaled Euclidean features at inference. It does not implement a Lorentz or Poincar\'e representation, geodesic prediction, or a Sharpness-Aware Minimization inner loop. We audit the executed objective and evaluate six conditions on PACS, VLCS, Office Home, and TerraIncognita. The completed design contains 384 runs: six conditions, four held-out targets, and four run seeds per dataset. Checkpoints are selected using only the three source-validation environments. Inference first averages paired seed differences within each held-out target; targets, rather than 16 seed-by-tar

translated_title: 面向域泛化的曲率启发标量特征缩放的受控评估
translated_abstract: 特定域的曲率是域泛化（DG）中一个颇具吸引力的想法，但曲率学习可能对应截然不同的计算方式。本文评估了一个刻意限定范围的实现：代码将其命名为 HyperDG，但它实际上是在训练期间通过学习到的正标量对欧几里得编码器特征进行重新缩放，并在推理时对未缩放的欧几里得特征使用普通线性分类器。它并未实现洛伦兹或庞加莱表示、测地线预测，或锐度感知最小化内循环。我们审计了实际执行的目标函数，并在 PACS、VLCS、Office Home 和 TerraIncognita 上评估了六种条件。完整的设计包含 384 次运行：六种条件、四个留出的目标域，以及每个数据集四个运行种子。检查点仅使用三个源验证环境进行选择。推理阶段首先在每个留出目标域内对配对种子的差异进行平均；目标域而非 16 个种子……
tldr: 本文对名为 HyperDG 的“曲率启发”方法进行了严格的受控审计与评估，发现其本质只是在训练时用学习到的正标量缩放欧氏特征、推理时使用普通线性分类器，并未真正实现双曲表示或曲率相关计算，并通过 384 次运行在四个基准数据集上验证了这一结论。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a controlled audit and evaluation of a so-called curvature-inspired method (HyperDG), showing that it merely rescales Euclidean encoder features with learned positive scalars during training and uses a plain linear classifier at inference—without any hyperbolic representation or curvature-based computation—across 384 runs on four domain generalization benchmarks.
